text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall from Period 1 to Period 10 despite several declines, so short-term swings alone are not a reason to change course.","I made no trades, which avoided impulsive reactions but does not by itself show that my holdings or cash allocation suit my goals.","I should keep risk and diversification in mind, since losses weigh heavily on me, while remembering that past price moves do not predict future ones."]}
